description:
## [1.5.0](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0) (2026-11-24)

### ✨ New Features

* custom icons from PNG files added with the patches, a merge and export tool, and the Equipment tab icon made with it ([f639b82](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/f639b8238bee66831d06dca5647f80857ec1126e))
* Edit button for the blacksmith's favor and mine access, and reforging hero armor ([b936f06](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/b936f0634bb7b668b355627f5178efd4ba577510))
* game previews on the main menu with new games from a seed, reusable seeds, and safe gardens ([b52e71b](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/b52e71be56e286e35972c02b335e9f18fd787c13))
* one Equipment backpack tab for melee weapons and armor ([b386486](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/b386486ccec7b853e3c71b3c5fc47111f2121a31))
* simpler game preview on the main menu, with Copy and Start New for its seed ([6190869](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/61908696658124227320a24e8fe1e6f996d9ab2b))
* tags editor shows the game tags' colors, a Show tag titles switch with an info button, titles that don't overlap and a lighter dim ([ed020b6](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/ed020b682d5c858b9795b1314859f774cabe3908))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Equipment tab icon is a round shield beside an upright sword; the icon tool can turn layers and fit them into any box ([bf98777](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/bf98777b3d376b55c107b731a398ef2b59e5c096))
* Equipment tab icon with the sword in front of the shield's right side ([b3737bd](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/b3737bdc3ba0e8b30909f78005e45e04f22f2e48))
* Equipment tab icon without the dark outline, with a full silver rim on the shield; icon tool options solid and edge ([a11d6aa](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/a11d6aa8d30df53de7c158aeaa32c23a2270c091))
* Equipment tab shows its combined icon and leaves out the pickaxe; Allow mine access; favor in steps of 500 ([4a2c5b6](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/4a2c5b6e0fa544a93e089657b502620b3fc8f8e1))
* reforging always keeps the hero armor, with the better armor's upgrades ([aef5bc7](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/aef5bc76319f507970e3a7f155ec0f5b9142c693))
* remove a duplicate fingerprint ([0d87efb](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/0d87efbc874fa39f4273837f45398257466d866f))
* smaller, centered Equipment tab icon with a softer rim, gold guard and slate grip; icon tool recolor option ([880c506](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/880c5069a1a1308e07fcb5dcd0b34081b77b9ff7))
